statement: One hour of 20 Hz electrical stimulation of the median nerve at the time of carpal tunnel surgery accelerated axon outgrowth and improved muscle reinnervation in patients compared with surgery alone.

context.model: chronic median nerve compression at the wrist

measurement.assay: motor unit number estimation and electrophysiology
measurement.effect: faster and more complete reinnervation with stimulation

replication.note: One group (Gordon); the mechanism is supported by extensive rodent work from the same laboratory.

limitations: a compression injury over a short distance, not a transection over a long one
electrophysiological endpoints rather than restored hand function

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
